title: Three Women in Mid-Century Attire, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot depicting three women dressed in formal or Sunday-best attire, standing outdoors in front of leafy foliage. The central figure wears wire-rimmed spectacles and holds a pair of white dress gloves, reflecting typical post-WWII women's etiquette and fashion standard. The young woman on the left wears a bold dark bead necklace over a white blouse.
